Professional Indemnity Insurance

In today’s fast-paced business world, even the most experienced companies and professionals can face unexpected claims of negligence, errors, or omissions. One misstep—or even a misunderstanding—can lead to costly legal battles and reputational damage.

This is why Professional Indemnity Insurance matters.

Professional Indemnity Insurance protects companies and professionals against claims for financial damage resulting from the advice and services they provide to their clients.

At TRINITY, we offer a comprehensive Professional Indemnity Insurance that provides financial support to meet the costs of legal actions and any damages that may become payable due to the following reasons:
• Breach of duty
• Negligent act
• Error and omission
• Misstatement or misleading statement
• Breach of warranty of authority committed in good faith
• Breach of confidentiality which occurs in the performance of or failure to perform professional services

What is the information needed for Professional Indemnity Insurance?
• Assured's Name
• Nature of Business/Profession
• Location
• Broker of Record (BOR) - form will be provided by Trinity
• KYC form – form will be provided by Trinity
